content.text: ▪︎20-32wks: cm above symphysis = GA in wks
▪︎IUP confirmed = gestational sac in uterus on TVUS + ⇡β-hCG
▪︎each visit: wt, BP, FHR, UA (infect, protein, glucose); ask about fetal mvt + vaginal bleed
▪︎TVUS @ initial visit if unsure of LMP or irreg cycles
▪︎1st visit labs (6–12wks): CBC, ABO + Rh type w/ antibody screen, UA + urine cx, syphilis, HIV, HBsAg, chlamydia, rubella immunity
▪︎Pap: cervical CA screening recs ⍉change in preg
▪︎selective (higher risk): thyroid, T2DM, measles, BV, trich, HSV, CMV, Zika, Chagas, TB, toxo, lead

▪︎offer genetic screening: CF + SMA → all; Hgb electrophoresis (esp African, Mediterranean, Middle Eastern, SE Asian, West Indian descent); fragile X if hx of fragile X–related d/o or ID; Eastern/Central European Jewish → additional (eg Tay-Sachs)
▪︎aneuploidy: noninvasive = NIPT, quad, msAFP; invasive = amniocentesis, CVS (10–13wks)

▪︎GBS screening: universal rectovaginal culture at 36 0/7–37 6/7 wks. Skip screening and give IAP if GBS bacteriuria at any point this pregnancy or prior infant w/ GBS disease. IAP: IV penicillin G (ampicillin alt); PCN allergy low-risk → cefazolin; high-risk → clindamycin if susceptible, else vancomycin. Unknown status → IAP if <37 wks, ROM ≥18 h, or intrapartum fever ≥38 °C.
▪︎BPP or NST if ⇡risk of antepartum fetal demise
•pushing begins once cervix 10cm dilated & 100% effaced & presenting part has descended
arrest of labor as cervix ≥6cm w/ ROM
: abrupt decline & return to baseline; vary in timing w/ contract
